title: Unit Event — The Vivid Old Tale

meta.Outline: After successfully hosting their own event for the first time, Vivid BAD SQUAD is determined to ride that wave closer to the heights of RAD WEEKEND. As they're discussing that legendary event, the members start to want to know more about Nagi, the woman who played a central role.

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Line:
Whew! I'm exhausted!
We can finally take a break...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm pretty tired too after singing so much... We even got to the park earlier than usual, and before we knew it, it was already dark out...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone.
Here are your lemonades.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I made sure not to make yours too sweet, Toya.

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line:
Heya!

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Sorry, we didn't mean to make you worried. We're all just really tired after our joint practice...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Joint practice?

rows.Line: Yeah, we're getting ready for our next show! Arata and the others are putting this event together and we asked them if we could all practice together whenever possible.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
We had our first one today...
And they were all really good...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Mita even kept going until he literally dropped.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I believe we were all very enthusiastic about it, and it turned out to be a very good practice.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really?! That sounds really tough, but also really fun!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, it does.
It's wonderful to see that you and your new friends are all working well together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We're also glad. I think that event really did let us take a small step towards surpassing RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And we have Akito to thank for the hint he gave us.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Way to go, Akito!
Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's with the cheering...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, we're nowhere near achieving that goal. We've still got a long ways to go before we can even think about surpassing that night.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right. And figuring out what you're actually going to need to do moving forward will be no small task.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: However, just as the “atmosphere” became a hint for you all last time, you may yet come across more helpful thoughts...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hints, huh...?
Hmmmm...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Do you have something, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I think I do!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Remember how seeing a video of RAD WEEKEND ended up being really helpful?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What if we did that again?
Don't you think it still has more to tell us?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: For example, Akito figured out how the atmosphere was totally different from any other event after seeing that footage, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, what if you focused on something else this time? You might discover something new by zooming in on everyone's singing or how they performed!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's right! I came up with that all on my own...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm... But they've already watched it a bunch of times, right? You really think we'll find anything else in there?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The chances of that do seem low, but I'm inclined to believe that it's worth a try...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I've seen it several times myself...
But I always find myself overwhelmed by everyone's technical mastery and the quality of their performances.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
So you may be right, Rin.
Trying to see how RAD WEEKEND differed from other events may lead us to some new discoveries.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, now I understand!
It makes so much sense coming from you, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What?
Len, what's that supposed to mean?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, relax. I'm kidding.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Alright, you two, settle down!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
So, let's give it another watch!
Would you all like to join us?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, are you sure?
Yes, since we missed our chance to last time.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
That's right!
Len and Rin kept saying how great it was while we were essentially still in the dark.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In that case, let's make it a viewing party. Let's see... We can show it on the screen we used during that event we did the other day.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, let's all help get things set up!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, here we go.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Wow...!
She's incredible...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Powerful too!
Her singing is so overwhelming that I'm getting sucked in.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
I couldn't believe it the first time either!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yeah, I didn't think it would be this amazing...! It's sending chills down my spine!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, you guys, be quiet!

rows.Speaker: Len, Luka & KAITO
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh my...
As rambunctious as ever, I see.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, they are.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But by comparison, Kohane and the others are...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I always end up focusing on how everyone sings, but I'm gonna try to learn more about their set lists today...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (With that one line in their very first song, they turned the live house on its head, got everyone's attention and kept drawing them in...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And they're doing a great job of transitioning between songs and keeping the crowd guessing...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But... Still...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(This Nagi person...
I can't look away from her...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(The lighting's amazing too...
It's hardly a big venue, but the lights are giving this stage a totally unique feel.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And standing in the center is...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (How is she able to get everyone so worked up? Is it her raw singing ability...? No, wait... There's definitely something else at work here.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It's as if everyone's energy and...something else...are swirling around her... Like she's at the center of this storm... Could this be...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Clues... Look for clues...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Argh. No, I always end up just watching it. I need to take a step back and look for clues and hints this time...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Still... RAD WEEKEND's just something else.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (My heart races every time I see it and I'm completely immersed in it before I realize what's going on...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, she really is amazing...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, how'd you guys do...?
Find anything good?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah! Um, so...
It was really, really awesome!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, what happened to looking for clues?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, um...!
B-But I got so caught up in watching it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! Oh, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But I understand how you feel.
I got really sucked in the first time too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I mean, that's why it's considered such a legendary night, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm not sure if this counts as a hint or clue, but I did notice something...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, what have you got for us?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I may be mistaken...
But something about all the performers' voices felt sad or dispirited for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sad...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.
But it was very subtle...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What?
Even though everyone was going totally nuts?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What if it's because my dad and his team decided to split up...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That event became their very last event and I'm guessing everyone else sort of already knew that.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, so because it was RADder's last event, everyone felt that they had to sing with everything they had?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Could that be it...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it would sort of explain why they all sang with so much passion..

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, I'm not sure if we can conclusively say that it's the reason why this event became so extraordinary...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Speaking of singing with passion...
The way Nagi sang by herself in the beginning left a big impression on me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Also, it kind of felt like Nagi, Taiga's little sister, was at the center of this entire event...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, Kohane, you too?
I sorta felt the same way.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Same here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: From the very first song, RAD WEEKEND's atmosphere felt way different from other events. And Nagi was the reason behind that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We all worked together and did everything we could to approach that level, but this Nagi person achieved that all by herself... Possibly from the get-go with just that one song...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, and it wasn't just that.
She seemed to make it so everyone around her could also do their best.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: My dad and Uncle Taiga seemed pretty tense when they took the stage, but Aunt Nagi found a way to get them to relax by talking to them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
And her power was so awesome!
I'm never gonna get tired of seeing what she did!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me... You know this Nagi person pretty well, right, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I do.
She's been looking after me since I was really little.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I used to practice singing with my dad, Uncle Taiga and her all the time back then too... Those days were so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Um, An...?
Would you mind telling us more about how things were like back then?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? You mean when I used to practice with Aunt Nagi?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. I have a feeling that we'll understand RAD WEEKEND a lot better by learning more about Nagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to hear more as well.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Nagi clearly stood at the center of RAD WEEKEND, so we certainly have much to gain by learning more about her.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Plus...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She stood toe to toe with Ken and Taiga in terms of singing ability, so I sorta just want to know more about her personally...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I agree.
I'm interested as well.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me too! Me too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Aunt Nagi, huh...?
Hmm... I don't mind telling you more about her, but where do I even start...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I know. How about that one time...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Aunt Nagi was always the absolute coolest...
A few years ago
Saturday morning

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna give it everything I've got again today!

rows.Line:
Hm?
Whoa, who's that...?! She's so little, but such an amazing singer...!

rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Line: Oh, boss, I was just cleaning up and noticed that little girl singing over there...

rows.Line: Ah, you're still new here, so I guess no one's told you yet...

rows.Line: You know KEN from RADder? That's his daughter, An.

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line: Wait, KEN's...?!

rows.Line: Hey, it looks like An's singing already!

rows.Line:
Yeah.

rows.Line: We're rooting for you, An!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Okay, that should be enough practice songs! Next, I should...

rows.Speaker: Attractive Lady
rows.Line:
Hi, An!
Getting another early start this morning?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Oh, good morning!
Did you just get off work?

rows.Speaker: Attractive Lady
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'm exhausted...
But I feel much better after hearing you sing, An♪ So, thank you♪

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're welcome!
Stop by to listen anytime!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Oh, you're from the record store! Good morning! Lots of cool piercings like always!

rows.Speaker: Frizzly-Haired Record Store Clerk
rows.Line:
Th-Thanks...
You seem as energetic as ever too, An...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Yup!
Oh, I was just practicing that song you taught me the other day!

rows.Speaker: Frizzly-Haired Record Store Clerk
rows.Line:
R-Really?
That's nice to hear...

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line: Wow, she seems like a really energetic kid...

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: Yeah, not only is she a great singer, she's got the charisma to match. Genetics are probably playing a big role, but... Hey, An!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, good morning!
How are you? Good?

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line:
Yeah, never better!
Are you at it again today? The thing Ken and the others were...?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Because “this street's the best place to practice singing”!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Daddy was supposed to watch me practice, but he's busy and still hasn't come yet...

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: I see. To be fair, he's a very popular figure...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Yup! It's like everyone's a fan of Daddy and his team!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Did you hire someone new?

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line:
O-Oh, um...
I started working here last week. It's nice to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: This one's a huge fan of your father, An.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Oh, really?!

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line: W-Wait, that's...!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Yeah, I totally get why too. I mean, Daddy's just so cool! You've got a good eye! Hehe♪

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: But I'm gonna become an even more amazing musician than him, so make sure to come see my events when I do!

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line: Oh, of course!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Now, I should get back to practicing!
See you guys later!

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line:
That's pretty much what she's like.
Pretty good kid, right...?

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line:
Yes, she is.
She really takes after KEN...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Whew. I got in a lot of singing...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (I figured out how to sing that new song and got that rap down too. Things are going really well!)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
(But it's almost noon...
Where are you, Daddy?)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (Even after saying that he'd come watch me practice today...)
An, over here!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Huh? That voice...!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Aunt Nagi! Uncle Taiga!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Hi there!
Having another morning practice, An?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Yeah, I've been practicing for like three hours now! Are you two here to talk to Daddy?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Yes, since we need to get ready for today's event. I hope you're looking forward to seeing us sing our hearts out!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Yeah, I am! Hehe... I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Haha. An just can't get enough of you, Nagi.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So, is Ken still at home?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: No, he got a call from someone and has been gone since! He was supposed to watch me practice...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me... He mentioned something about wanting to talk to some kids before they make their big debut. It could have to do with that.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Unlike me, a lot of them see him as their role model since he always keeps an eye out for them.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: You say that, but I've seen you lend a helping hand on more than one occasion, Taiga.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Yeah, I remember how you helped cheer that one kid up after they dropped their ice cream!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
I couldn't just leave them, could I?
I mean, if that were me, dropping my ice cream would've felt like the end of the world.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: True. I probably would've felt awful the rest of the day too...!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Haha. Oh, quit exaggerating, you two.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Oh, I just got a message from Ken...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Yeah, he says he still can't come...
Which means we have some time to kill.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Grr! Daddy!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Oh, I know! Can you listen to me sing, Aunt Nagi, Uncle Taiga?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: I practiced lots and lots, so I bet I'll sound really good!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Sure, I'd love to hear you sing!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: But I'll probably fall asleep if you don't deliver, okay?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
No problem!
Daddy even said that I sounded great yesterday!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Oh, he did?
Then, I'm looking forward to hearing what you have in store for us♪

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Alright, here I go!!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Not bad!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Oh, stop there!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: That last part. I think you'll sound a lot better and more powerful if you don't use your falsetto. Here, like this.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Wow...!
How did you do that just now?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Start by using your diaphragm to project your voice and send it up towards your head. It's okay if you're not in pitch on your first try.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Okay!
Um...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Yeah, there you go!
Next, relax a bit more and try to keep your throat open... Go!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Yay! I did it!
Thank you so much, Aunt Nagi!!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Haha. It's always a pleasure to teach you since you're such a quick learner, An. Now, fist bump!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Fist bump!

rows.Line:
Heh.
You two are more like sisters at this point... Hm?

rows.Line: You wanna go?! Meet me out front!

rows.Line: Oh no! Th-This looks bad...!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I'm gonna go talk to them.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:

Aunt Nagi!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Sorry, everyone.
Mind letting me through?

rows.Speaker: Onlookers
rows.Line: Hm? Isn't that...? Nagi?!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Honestly, fighting in broad daylight.

rows.Speaker: Boy Rapper A

rows.Line: Hmm... You'd think rappers would choose better words, no? I mean, “hag” and “interrupt” don't really rhyme.

rows.Line: Huh? You making fun of me, lady?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Uncle Taiga, is she gonna be okay...?!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Relax. This is nothing for her.

rows.Speaker: Boy Rapper B
rows.Line: You've got nothing to do with this, so stay out of our way!

rows.Line: Actually, I have everything to do with this. My prized pupil's trying to sing here, so I'd prefer it if you didn't cause such a big commotion.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: From what I can tell, it sounds like you aren't happy with how your battle was judged and decided to choose the worst option by picking a fight. Did I miss anything?

rows.Speaker: Boy Rapper A
rows.Line: Grr...!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:

rows.Line: Alright, why don't you have a rematch right here...?

rows.Speaker: Boy Rappers A & B
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Don't give me that look.
Rappers should be ready to throw down whenever, right?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
And I'll be the judge this time.
You all want to hear them sing, right?!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: So, what do you two say? You're not about to turn tail and run in front of all these people... Are you?

rows.Line:

rows.Line: I know! Don't worry!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Hey, that verse was great!
You weren't very eloquent during that fight just now, so it's refreshing to hear that you have a good vocabulary.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
This is awesome!
Well, maybe not as awesome as Aunt Nagi♪

rows.Speaker: Boy Rapper B
rows.Line: Next, my turn! Get ready!

rows.Speaker: Boy Rappers A & B
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
You both did great!
But I think we have to call it a draw.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: However, if you're still not satisfied, would you like to do another round?

rows.Speaker: Boy Rapper A
rows.Line: A-After a quick breather...!

rows.Speaker: Onlooker A
rows.Line: Then, let us do a battle in the meantime!

rows.Speaker: Onlooker B
rows.Line: Hey, that sounds fun! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Aunt Nagi, I wanna do a battle too!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Okay, how about we do one?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Really?! Yay!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: After causing such a big stir too... But I guess kids will be kids. Anyway, I'll just sit back and enjoy the show.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hm? Isn't that...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: And the winner is... Taiga!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Uncle Taiga was so awesome! And super cool!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: You ended up joining in on the fun after saying that you'd just sit back and watch things unfold.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: My plan was to spice things up a little, but maybe I went a bit overboard.

rows.Speaker: Boy Rapper A
rows.Line: That old dude's way too good at rapping! What's going on here?!

rows.Speaker: Boy Rapper B
rows.Line: Same with the people from the crowd that jumped in partway through...! Even that little kid was totally off the hook!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Just where exactly do you think you are right now? This is Vivid Street. Rapping and singing are how we greet each other around here.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: But if you've learned your lesson, quit fighting like knuckleheads and get good.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Exactly.
You can win as long as you get the crowd going!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I mean, you're both doing this because you love it, right?

rows.Speaker: Boy Rapper A
rows.Line: W-Well...

rows.Speaker: Boy Rapper B
rows.Line: Yeah... We are...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
(They stopped another fight...?
Honestly, don't they ever get tired of doing that? Still...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Hey, can we go again?!
I think I can do better this time!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Okay!
Let's do another one together!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I'll start!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (I guess it isn't all bad since An looks like she's having fun.)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hey, Nagi, Taiga!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Hi, Daddy!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Oh, you're finally here.
You came so late that you missed our little event.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Sorry about that.
But you decided to put on an event before our actual one?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
What's wrong with that?!
It's not like we get to hear RADder rap every day!

rows.Speaker: Boy Rapper A
rows.Line: Wait, RADder...? You guys are RADder...?!

rows.Speaker: Boy Rapper B
rows.Line:
W-We're so sorry...!!
We had no idea who we'd been talking to...!!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Don't apologize to us. You should be telling that to everyone from the live house and all the other participants.

rows.Speaker: Boy Rapper A
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
Yes, we'll do that...

rows.Speaker: Boy Rapper B
rows.Line: Again, we're sorry for causing so much trouble...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Yeah, it is important to assert yourself sometimes, but it's just as important to keep a cool head.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Still, all jokes aside, you two weren't bad, and you're taking things seriously enough to fight about it.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: So, we'll be looking forward to seeing how you both do moving forward!

rows.Speaker: Boy Rappers A & B
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I'm really glad they stopped fighting!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Me too.
Also, An, your rapping has improved a lot. Practicing every day is really starting to pay off.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
Hold on. More importantly...!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Daddy, where were you?!
You said you'd watch me practice, but it's already noon!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Yeah, sorry about that...
Things sort of just dragged on.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: But I promise to watch you practice tomorrow morning. It's Sunday, so I should be able to stay with you until noon.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yeah. And to make up for what happened, you can sit in the VIP section during today's event.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Whoa! Are you sure?!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yes, there's going to be an opening it seems and the manager personally requested you fill that seat.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Woohoo!!
Thank you so much, Daddy!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You're welcome. Anyway, let's get going.
Vivid Street
se_event_tale_2022_006

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Awesome!
I got three at once!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Grr...!
No matter how many times I play these arcade shooters, I can never get used to them...!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Alright, it's starting to get dark, so let's head back once those two are done playing their game.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Sounds good.
But I'm still amazed by how much energy An has after practicing all morning.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Wait, An, don't take that weapon!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
You snooze, you lose!
I'm gonna take the health pack too.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: No, I needed that health pack!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Drats, I lost again...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
An, one more time!
I can't leave after that!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: You really hate losing, huh, Aunt Nagi? But I like how you're not afraid to stand back up♪

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Guh... That smirk... Just who exactly are you taking after?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Well, Nagi, you probably.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Oops... She's copying me?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: By the way, I'm pretty good at this game.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Shut it!
I still want another go!
I'll change characters this time and...

rows.Speaker: Live House Staff
rows.Line:
E-Excuse me...!
Do you all have a moment to talk?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, you're Kimura from “Ultramarine”. You seem startled. What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Live House Staff
rows.Line: The thing is, we've run into a bit of trouble...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Trouble?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
(Hmm...
They all look really serious...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (This might take a while...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah, that's not good...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
If that's the case, I'll head over.
You two stay here with An.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
What...?!
You're leaving, Aunt Nagi?!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Don't worry, An...
We'll get to play again soon.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: But I wanna play again now...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Hehe. I know, dear.
I don't like leaving after losing either.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: But right now, someone from the live house we usually perform at needs my help, so I want to be there for them...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: You'd try to help someone if you saw that they were in need, right, An?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's what I like to hear!
And it's very cool of you, An!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
So, I'll be off...
Let's play again tomorrow, An!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Oh...
There she goes...
The next day
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Check this out!
From downtown!
se_event_tale_2022_008

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Whoa! That was awesome!
You made that shot from so far away...!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Hehe. I am pretty good at basketball.
Wanna give it a try, An?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Can I have the ball?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: First, why don't you try aiming for the backboard behind the rim? Point your toes forward and relax as you hold the ball up...
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
That was great!
I didn't realize basketball was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Oh, Aunt Nagi, Uncle Taiga!
Wanna have dinner at our place?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Oh, at your place? Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yeah, we got some steaks as thanks from the team we helped out the other day and was thinking about grilling them up.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Really?! Well, if you don't mind!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Yay!
Mommy's really good at grilling steaks too!
se_event_tale_2022_010

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: They're constructing a really big building here! What's it gonna be?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Oh, this sign might tell us.
Let's see... It says it's going to be for “Kamiyama High School.”

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Really?! This is gonna be a school?!
It'd be kinda fun to go exploring♪

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: An, construction sites aren't exactly safe places, so don't get too close.
se_event_tale_2022_010

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
I'm not sure you meant that at all.
These sorts of places can be pretty dangerous, so please be careful, alright?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
I know!
It's just... I'm a little curious.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: That reminds me of how we used to sneak into school at night and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Wait, you did?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
T-Taiga!
Now's really not the time!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: If anything, we were sort of forced to sneak in... If only Nagi hadn't...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Hadn't what? Aunt Nagi, did you do something bad? Why did you guys have to sneak in?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: No, I can't tell you that!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Aww... Why not...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
I'll tell you when you're a little older!
More importantly, look! We're almost home!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (Once we get home, we're gonna have steaks, practice singing, play games... I can't wait!)

rows.Speaker: Young Musician
rows.Line:
Oh, um...!
Pardon me for being so sudden, but do you all have a moment?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Oh, I remember you. We met at that one event the other day... “Riot Party”, right? Weren't there four of you?

rows.Speaker: Young Musician
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Yes, that's us!
I can't believe you remembered us!

rows.Speaker: Young Musician
rows.Line: I know this coming straight out of left field... But the thing is, RADder, we need your help...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Conversations that start like this usually don't end well in my experience...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: But for now, can you tell us what's going on?

rows.Speaker: Young Musician
rows.Line: We were going to sign with this one label, but we noticed today that some conflicts might arise in terms of who owns what based on what we saw in the fine print...

rows.Speaker: Young Musician
rows.Line: We expressed our concern because it didn't seem right, and they responded by telling us to decide whether or not to sign by the end of today.

rows.Speaker: Young Musician
rows.Line: Then, I heard from some people around here that RADder's probably good at dealing with these sorts of situations... Would you mind if I asked for your opinions...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
By the end of today...?
Geez, talk about being callous.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah, if this label's gonna stick it to you that much, why sign with them at all?

rows.Speaker: Young Musician
rows.Line:
We thought that as well...
But one of my teammates is going to quit if we don't land a deal this year...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
I see...
If that's the case, Taiga, let's hear what he has to say.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Ken's our best negotiator...
But we're better at handling things then they go south.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: You're making me sound like some kind of ruffian. Still, I don't mind helping.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Sorry, guys. I really appreciate it...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: You guys are going, Aunt Nagi...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, An.
I really want to hang out with you, but I need to go for a bit...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: We can have some yummy steaks together in the future sometime...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Alright, wish us luck!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (She left again...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Don't worry. I'm sure you'll get to play again soon. I know. Why don't we do some singing practice together when we get back...?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Huh? Really?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yes, really. We can practice as much as you like.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Woohoo!!
One week later
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: What?! You can't stay to watch me practice?! But you always do on your days off!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
Something came up and...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Something came up...?
Did someone ask you to help them again?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: The manager of “VIOLET” collapsed... You know, the one on the corner?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Oh no! The manager collapsed...?!
Is he okay?!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Luckily, he was taken to the hospital in a hurry, so he's fine now. However, there's an event starting there tomorrow and he asked us to help run things.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
(But someone else can do that...
Daddy and his team don't actually have to go...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Like I said before, you should practice somewhere in town since everyone will be there to watch you.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (Does that mean Daddy and the others are...?)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: An, is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Um, Daddy...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: You and your team are always running around helping everyone in town while telling me to sing out on the street somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Is it because you really don't want to watch me practice...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making you think that...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: An, we want to be with you as much as we can. That includes Nagi, Taiga and of course, myself. We all care about you very much.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: And there's a reason why I've been telling you to sing on this street.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: An, I genuinely believe that singing around here will benefit you greatly.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Benefit me...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yes. Nagi, Taiga and I were all able to grow as singers because of this town.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
In so many ways too...
And I'm sure you'll understand that in time, An.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
It's almost time for that meeting.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I promise to watch you practice next Sunday around noon...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I have some business to take care of in the morning, but I should be free afterward. Nagi and Taiga also said they'll be available too.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Yes, that's a promise.
But for now, I need to go.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Okay, good luck...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (There he goes...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
(Mommy's at work too...
I'm really all alone today...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (But Daddy said he and his team became good singers because they sang here...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: I should go practice...

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: Hey, here for another morning practice...? Hm? What's wrong? You seem a little down...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Huh?
Oh, no... There's nothing wrong!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
(Do I really sound that unhappy...?
That just means I need to try harder...)

rows.Speaker: Attractive Lady
rows.Line:
Hi, An!
You sound as good as ever today!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Oh, hi...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
I don't sound good at all...
I can't even hit the high notes...

rows.Speaker: Attractive Lady
rows.Line:
What?
I don't think so! You're better than a lot of the grown-ups around here!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: That's not true...

rows.Speaker: Frizzly-Haired Record Store Clerk
rows.Line: An, is everything alright? You don't sound very happy today. Is your throat okay?

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: Oh, is it because your dad's been too busy to watch you practice...?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Frizzly-Haired Record Store Clerk
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Attractive Lady
rows.Line:
Don't worry, An.
Once he has time, I'm sure... No, I'm absolutely certain that he'll come watch you practice.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
(He's right...
He promised to watch me practice next Sunday...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (So, until then, I need to keep practicing...!)
Sunday

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: I'm going now!!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
(Finally, it's Sunday...!
I get to practice with Daddy and everyone at noon!)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Just two more hours until then...!
Alright, I'll start warming up!
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Geez, that took forever...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: However, we finally landed ourselves a deal with an overseas label. It did take a while, but we're at last taking the next step.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Thank you for handling all the negotiations, Ken. We have so many goals that we just won't be able to accomplish with a major Japanese label.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Yeah.
And I want An to see the world too.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Oh, speaking of which, it's almost time!
We should go see An!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: We were so busy this week that we couldn't help her at all, so let's teach her as much as we can today!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Right. She's been getting ready since this morning, so she might be all tuckered out...

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: Hey, Ken! You guys!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, it's the manager.
And you're the new hire, yes...?

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line:
Yes!
So, I apologize for what I'm about to ask...

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: Unfortunately, it turns out the main guest we booked for today's event can't make it, so we could really use a hand...!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Huh? Your main guest?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Hang on. Today's event...?
Wasn't “WIRED” supposed to perform?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: WIRED? As in the really famous American group? How do you guys keep getting these big catches?

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line: Well, the owner's actually a huge fan and asked them to perform...

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: Exactly. We prepared far in advance and even got other musicians to join after hearing the big news. However...

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: They're having trouble getting past immigration and can't do much of anything right now. We don't even know if or when they'll be let through...

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: Normally, we'd have to cancel if our main guest bails on us, but in this case, people have traveled a long ways and even stayed the night in anticipation of this event...

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line: As for a team that can match WIRED and take their spot as the main guest...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Now I get it. And that's what brought you guys here.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Yeah, in terms of other musicians who can match what WIRED can do...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Ken...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: The live house's reputation is on the line here...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Especially since people have arrived the day before to see this event.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: We have to help, Nagi, Taiga...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Only we can fill the shoes that WIRED has left behind.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Yeah...
You're right.

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line:
I really appreciate it...!
If you'll come with me now.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: That's fine, but I'll need to let An know first.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
I can't get ahold of her...
She has been practicing since this morning...

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line:
Then, I'll go find her!
The rest of you can head to the live house with the manager!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Alright, thanks.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Please tell An that I'm sorry and I promise to spend the entire day with her next time...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: She should be singing somewhere in the middle of Vivid Street.

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line:
Understood!!
You can count on me!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Alright, let's head over...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I'm so sorry, An...

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Where are Daddy and the others?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (He said that they'd be meeting with someone on another street, so I'll go take a look!)

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line: Hmm... An should be around here somewhere... But I don't see her anywhere... What should I do?

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line: No, she has to be somewhere on this street...! I have to find her fast...!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Hmm... I don't see them.
They're supposed to be meeting somewhere around here, right?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: And they usually go down this path whenever they stop by to see me practice...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (Okay, I'll wait here today since they always come from that way!)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: I hope they get here soon...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (Seriously, where are they...?)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (I couldn't get a hold of anyone when I went home and called...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (So, maybe they forgot about our promise...)

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
There you are...!!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Huh?
You're the live house's...

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line:
I'm sorry for not finding you sooner.
Your father and his team asked me to relay you a message.

rows.Line: He did?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. We even took walks around Vivid Street together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see... So Taiga believes that we need to at least “take a look at this city” if we actually wish to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But what exactly are we supposed to be looking for...? I doubt he meant just literally looking at stuff around town.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right. Based on what you've all said, physically looking seems to be a small part of a bigger picture.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... Well, you can find live houses and record stores... Is there anything else that comes to mind?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Other than those things...? People, I guess...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This may just be me, but everyone in Vivid Street's really friendly and loves music...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But if they weren't like that, we'd probably be talking about a pretty different place.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah... I have to agree based on your story, An.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hang on. What does knowing what everyone's like have to do with music?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm not really sure, but Taiga talks about those kinds of “practices” a lot so they must be related somehow...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, what if you're supposed to put on an event and invite all the locals to be in the audience?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Didn't they do precisely that during their last event?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we did. Some weren't from Vivid Street, but most were local residents or musicians who've been performing there for a long time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... Then, that's not the answer...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, “taking a look at this city” does seem really important...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Aunt Nagi also cared a lot about everyone around town...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Very true...
Let's keep doing our best to unravel this enigma...

rows.Speaker: An & Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, it's getting pretty late...!
We've been brainstorming for a while now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we have. We should head home soon before we all get scolded.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: At least we won't have the police coming after us like An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Was that really necessary?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Oh...

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line:
Hey, An!
How's it going?

rows.Speaker: Veteran Staff
rows.Line:
Hi, everyone. Welcome back.
I heard that the last VBS event was a huge hit. Way to go!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. You should both come see us next time! Oh, or should we just have here be our next venue?♪

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line:
That'd be great!
Our place can be the site of your very own legend!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Everybody loves An so much.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Uh oh...!
Sorry, I really need to get home soon or else my dad's going to start worrying!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Same. Why don't we call things here?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
See you guys later.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay, everyone! Bye bye!
We'll see you guys later too!

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: Yeah, see you tomorrow!
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm back!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hey, welcome back. You were out pretty late today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup! On top of practicing, we spent a lot of time discussing our next event and talking about all sorts of other stuff.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I even got to tell Kohane and the others about Aunt Nagi today.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: About Nagi?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. They all seem to believe that she was central to making RAD WEEKEND what it was.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. I mean, I know all three of you were key figures, but the way Aunt Nagi kicked things off left a huge impression on everyone.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Her first song left me totally stunned too!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A few questions later, I was telling them a story about Aunt Nagi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Remember when I was still in elementary school and ran away? I told them about how she found me that time!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I remember.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. The worried look I saw on your face that time made me so happy too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It felt really rare because you always seem so calm and collected, Dad!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Hold on.
I worry about things just like anyone else.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Are you sure about that?
I haven't seen you like that ever since...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of which...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: After telling everyone about Aunt Nagi, I was told that I'm a lot like her... What do you think? Am I?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I really hope that I have made some progress since I've sorta been chasing after her...!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You and Nagi...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yeah, you two are alike...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We are?
Hehe. Hearing that from you makes me so happy!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna keep doing my best to be like Aunt Nagi in order to surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I'm not sure how I feel about you becoming that relentless...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Anyway, An, we shouldn't be getting any more customers, so can you start locking up for me?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, sure!
I'll switch the sign to closed!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, the plate's flipped...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh wow... The sky's so clear tonight!
And the stars look so pretty!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (The city lights seem even prettier for some reason. Why is that?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Through the eyes of someone not from here, this place can seem pretty rough or dangerous.)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: They all care about you just this much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Maybe it's because I know everyone from around town's here...and doing their best...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
What are you up to right now in America, Aunt Nagi? I really wish you'd send a message or something every once in a while.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, I can send her one!
That might take her by surprise!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I wanna tell her all about the others, the events we've been doing and lots more...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna do everything I can for our next event! I'm gonna make it so I stun her the next time she sees me!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They all seem to believe that Nagi was central to making RAD WEEKEND what it was.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (The time to tell them appears to be fast approaching...)
